entries.speaker: Confidants and Fusion
entries.en: When you fuse a Persona that has the same[n]arcana as a Confidant you have a bond with,[n]the Persona will gain extra experience upon[n]its creation.

entries.speaker: Confidants and Fusion
entries.en: This bonus experience is called [clr 2]Arcana Burst[clr 27].[n]The higher the related Confidant rank is, the[n]more experience the Persona will gain.
